name: Encroaching Wildlife
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
My caravan was destined for the eastern coast, but we did not reach our goal.  Lost Ones attacked us, killing guards and dashing supplies.

I alone survived their assault.  I have sworn to protect what supplies remain, but wild creatures skulk near.  Please, help me defend my camp from the beasts!
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, 10 Sorrow Spinners and 10 Swamp Jaguars then return to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.
narrative.offerRewardText: The sounds of animals are now faint, more distant. Thank you, adventurer. Now let's hope they don't return!
narrative.requestItemsText: The swamp creatures press close, adventurer. Please, you must defend the camp!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 35 to 42, 11,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Encroaching Wildlife
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, 10 Sorrow Spinners and 10 Swamp Jaguars then return to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.objectiveText: Find the Caravan Chest in the Fallow Sanctuary, obtain the Wizards' Reagents and bring to Watcher Biggs.

quests.name: Driftwood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Sundried Driftwood to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Deliver the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shipment to Nethergarde to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.
